events.title: New heat cluster · 387 MW from 4 spots · none in the 24 h before
events.summary: Satellites saw 4 hot spots in this ~{AREA} area on the latest passes (strongest 153 MW) where there was no heat earlier in the day. Most new clusters are farm or bush burning; it can also be a new wildfire, an industrial or fuel fire, a strike, a volcano or a gas flare.
